rationale: Parkinson flaxseed omega-3 plus vitamin-E trials (PMID28342967, PMID30554092) report total UPDRS without pain items. The vitamin-D add-on (PMID42529699) has baseline imbalance. The endometriosis cohort is assessed separately in this rubric.

The original randomized study abstract names an ethyl-ester comparator and an omega-3 index association with Epworth. Secondary arm means are inconclusive and are unverified for time point and denominator in the original. The contrast does not identify refined culinary corn oil in Parkinson disease.

The original author abstract reports a relative pain-domain advantage for pumpkin oil added to tadalafil. Overall response was 11 of 25 versus 12 of 25 with tadalafil alone. Numerical domain data and cold-press grade remain unverified.
